chapters.title: Introduction: Papers That Crafted the Modern World
Chapter 1: The Role of Monetary Policy – Milton Friedman
Chapter 2: The Use of Knowledge in Society – Friedrich Hayek

episode.tagline: We think of papers as boring -- but they contain ideas, and ideas change the world.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay and Amit take us through four papers -- actually, three papers and one essay -- that shaped the way they think, and how millions of others think as well. The power of a great idea is that it can help explain the world better than before -- and all progress is built on better understanding.
